text:
tara: Heads up: our new Next + LangChain sample sometimes drops call context on retry, causing missing functions in tools calls during SSR. Anyone else hit this?

oliver: saw a brief flake yesterday. sounds like middleware ordering — retry runs before the context-injector.

jun: can you share snippet?

tara: gist with minimal repro: https://gist.github.com/tara/llama-next-repro

jun: reproduced. sequence: initial request fails with 502 from model, retry fires, but the request body is rebuilt without `tools` array from ctx.

oliver: probable cause: we stringify request at send time and retry uses the original parsed object, but our context-injector attaches tool definitions lazily in a downstream hook. If retry bypasses that hook, it won't have tools.

tara: quick fix: ensure retry middleware re-runs the request pipeline or move context injection to an earlier middleware that runs before retries.

jun: added a small patch locally moving attachTools into the preflight auth middleware; seems to fix SSR repro. I'll open PR.

doc-bot: created INF-4899 "sdk-js: ensure pipeline hooks run on retries for tool/context injection" and attached jun's patch link.

oliver: also add a tiny integration test in examples/next-langchain that simulates a failing first response and asserts tool payload present on retry. Use nock to force the 502.

tara: will update the example and the quickstart note about ordering. thanks all :tada:
